description: This Java class implements the <call-object-method> element for the OFBiz Mini language, providing functionality to call methods on objects during the execution of a Mini language script. It handles parsing XML configuration for method name, target object, parameters, and return field, and executes the method call via reflection.

classes.name: CallObjectMethod
classes.description: Represents the <call-object-method> element, allowing invocation of an object's method with optional parameters and return value handling.

methods.name: CallObjectMethod
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on an XML element, parsing attributes and child elements for method invocation setup.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the method call on the specified object within the given method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <call-object-method> element with its attributes.
